W01.drivers: Narrow, sloping shoulders over a short trunk that is egg-shaped in profile: rounded chest and belly and a rounded upper back. Very narrow pelvis. Spindly legs whose knee/shin contour bulges forward in profile. Long arms with the hands hanging to mid-thigh. Long, flat, elongated feet.
axial_cues: egg/barrel-shaped trunk in profile with convex back and convex front
narrow pelvis barely wider than waist
limb_cues: spindly thighs with forward knee/shin bulge in profile
long arms, hands low on thigh

structure.axial_section_shape: rounded ovoid thorax-abdomen block, deep in profile, narrow in front
structure.joint_integration: knobby, abrupt knees and wrists; shoulders slope into arms without a defined deltoid shelf
structure.segment_relations: short trunk, long thin legs, long arms, oversized flat feet
structure.load_path: weight sits forward over the knees; slight knee flexion and forward curve before reaching long flat feet

non_structural_factors.notes: Thin limbs reinforce it, but the ovoid trunk and the leg/foot proportions drive the read

W02.drivers: Typical lean adult male proportions; straight legs; ordinary pelvis and shoulders

structure.load_path: vertical through straight legs to the heels

W03.drivers: Ordinary skeleton; soft belly and prominent buttocks in profile; slightly rounded chest

structure.axial_section_shape: ordinary trunk with soft anterior abdominal bulge

non_structural_factors.notes: mild softness, within the normal range

W05.drivers: Nearly identical to W01: ovoid deep trunk with rounded back and belly in profile, narrow sloping shoulders, narrow pelvis, spindly legs with a forward knee bulge, long arms, long flat feet
limb_cues: thin legs with forward knee/shin bulge

structure.axial_section_shape: rounded ovoid thorax-abdomen, deep in profile
structure.joint_integration: abrupt knobby knees and wrists; weak shoulder shelf
structure.segment_relations: short trunk, long thin legs and arms, large flat feet
structure.load_path: forward over slightly flexed knees onto long flat feet

W06.drivers: Ordinary male proportions; slightly fuller belly and buttocks

W07.drivers: Typical lean male proportions, slightly broad shoulders

W08.drivers: Typical proportions with slight chest softness; normal pelvis

W09.drivers: Typical slim proportions; slightly wider hips

W11.drivers: Massive, heavily segmented muscle masses. Very broad shoulders and a deep V-taper to a narrow waist. Huge fists hanging at mid-thigh. Short, massive legs with bulging calves set in a wide stance. Very large, wide feet with splayed toes. In profile the trunk pitches forward and the knees are bent. The sculpt has knotted, armor-like contours, and a detached fragment floats in front of it in profile.
axial_cues: very broad shoulder girdle with trapezius mass
limb_cues: short thick legs with large calves

structure.axial_section_shape: wide, deep inverted-trapezoid thorax over a small pelvis
structure.joint_integration: joints buried in muscle masses; segments read as knotted lumps rather than smooth transitions
structure.segment_relations: large upper body, short heavy legs, oversized hands and feet
structure.load_path: trunk weight carried forward through flexed knees into wide-set, broad feet

non_structural_factors.notes: An extremely muscular human (B) is the main alternative. Hand and foot size, short legs and the flexed forward stance push it to C.

groups.label: ordinary slim to average adult bodies
hyper-muscular, broad-shouldered, short-legged, big hands and feet, flexed stance

distinguishing_features: W01/W05 are slight and narrow-framed: an ovoid deep trunk, sloping shoulders, thin knobby limbs and long flat feet. W11 is the reverse: massively broad and muscular, with a V-tapered trunk, short heavy legs, huge hands and wide feet, and a forward-pitched, bent-knee stance. They differ in frame width, limb mass and trunk shape, so they separate easily even as silhouettes.
